story_overview: MSVBench story 17 (Arabian Folktales). Aladdin plays with his friends at a street corner, his face lit up with a bright smile. Aladdin stops fooling around and begins to focus on business. Years later, Aladdin becomes king, beloved by his subjects.

video_prompts: Daytime, city street, lively atmosphere, street vendors at the corner, scattered toys and snack wrappers on the ground, bright sunlight, gentle breeze. Aladdin stands at the center of the frame, playing joyfully with his friends, his expression happy and movements lively, with toys and snack wrappers scattered on the ground. Aladdin plays with his friends at a street corner, his face lit up with a bright smile. Full shot, eye level shot.

Daytime, city street, mysterious atmosphere, street vendors at the corner, scattered toys and snack wrappers on the ground, sunlight obscured by clouds, lighting slightly dim. The sorcerer stands beside Aladdin, his expression sly, while Aladdin looks puzzled, holding a toy in his hand. A mysterious sorcerer approaches Aladdin, claiming to be his long-lost uncle. Medium shot, side shot.

Evening, inside Aladdin's small house, cozy atmosphere, simple furniture, an oil lamp on the table, faint light filtering through the window. The sorcerer sits at the table, his hands clasped, expression sincere, while Aladdin stands nearby listening, his expression trusting, the oil lamp on the table flickering slightly. The sorcerer deceives Aladdin with sweet words, promising to take him on a grand venture. Medium close up, eye level shot.

Daytime, jungle clearing, mysterious atmosphere, dense trees surrounding, a stone slab on the ground, dappled light filtering through the leaves. The sorcerer stands at the center of the clearing, Aladdin nearby, as the sorcerer chants a spell, the ground splits open, revealing the tunnel entrance. The sorcerer leads Aladdin to a clearing in the jungle, chants a spell, and the ground splits open, revealing a tunnel. Wide shot, high-angle shot.

Inside the tunnel, gloomy atmosphere, moss-covered walls, scattered rubble on the ground, faint light in the distance. Aladdin stands inside the tunnel, expression terrified, clutching an old oil lamp, the tunnel exit sealing before him as rubble falls. Aladdin follows instructions but, upon returning, the sorcerer, enraged at not receiving the lamp immediately, seals the tunnel. Medium close up, low-angle shot.

Inside the tunnel, gloomy atmosphere, moss-covered walls, scattered rubble on the ground, faint light. Aladdin rubs the lamp, the Genie emerges from it, glowing sapphire-blue, Aladdin's expression shocked. In despair, Aladdin rubs the lamp and accidentally summons the Genie. Close up, eye level shot.

Daytime, city market, bustling atmosphere, numerous stalls, people coming and going, bright sunlight. Aladdin stands at the center of the market, dressed neatly in merchant attire, expression focused, exchanging goods and money with customers. Aladdin stops fooling around and begins to focus on business. Full shot, high-angle shot.

Daytime, city garden, romantic atmosphere, flowers in full bloom, fountain flowing, sunlight bathing the garden. Aladdin and the princess meet in the garden, sitting on the grass, Aladdin looking awestruck, the princess smiling shyly. Aladdin meets the beautiful princess and falls deeply in love with her. Medium shot, side shot.

Daytime, palace hall, solemn atmosphere, golden decorations, tall stone pillars, sunlight streaming through the windows. Aladdin stands at the center of the hall, expression determined, his right fist over his heart, the king seated on the throne, expression stern, pointing at Aladdin as he sets the harsh conditions. Aladdin gathers the courage to propose to the king, who sets harsh conditions. Medium long shot, eye level shot.

Daytime, small palace garden, serene atmosphere, flowers in bloom, a new oil lamp on a stone table, sunlight filtering through the leaves. The princess stands by the stone table, expression trusting, the sorcerer disguised as a peddler, expression sly, swapping the magic lamp for a new one. The sorcerer disguises himself as a peddler, gains the princess's trust, and swaps the magic lamp for a new one. Medium close up, side shot.

Nighttime, outside a distant palace, tense atmosphere, desolate surroundings, the palace appearing lonely under the moonlight, scattered signs of battle on the ground. Aladdin confronts the sorcerer outside the palace, Aladdin pointing angrily at the sorcerer, the sorcerer looking terrified and about to flee, moonlight illuminating both. Aladdin discovers the deception, goes through hardships to find the princess, and schemes to kill the sorcerer, reclaiming the lamp. Wide shot, low-angle shot.

Daytime, palace garden, joyful atmosphere, flowers in bloom, fountain flowing, bright sunlight. Aladdin and the princess swing in the garden, expressions blissful, the princess in an elegant court dress, Aladdin in neat merchant attire, the Genie standing nearby, smiling. Aladdin and the princess regain happiness, cherish the lamp, and live joyfully ever after. Full shot, eye level shot.

Daytime, palace hall, solemn atmosphere, golden decorations, tall stone pillars, subjects gathered in the hall. Aladdin sits on the throne, expression dignified, dressed in royal attire, his subjects looking up at him admiringly, the hall filled with cheers. Years later, Aladdin becomes king, beloved by his subjects. Medium long shot, high-angle shot.
